amendments.summary: RMSE co-primary; DB-MAPE guardrail; BatteryLife paper baselines as reference set with local reproductions; Phase 1 = most accurate model (no efficiency-first track); budget raised
Development room: promising directions get up to 3 evidence-led follow-ups; close after 4 consecutive DISCARDs; non-promising get one repair (program.md §7)
Phase 2 (and later Phase 3) unlock when the previous phase closes by target OR no-gain stop/hard limit; best 3-seed-confirmed model frozen; TARGET_NOT_MET recorded

seen/unseen-condition metric; Phase-1 focus on unseen-condition generalization (D1 SOC-window-aware view, D2 reference-pair, D3 learned-shape head); paper baselines reduced to CPTransformer + CPGRU as reference
New project v6_auto on ZN-coin, same workflow as v4_auto; 3 paper splits (2021/42/2024) reported as mean ± std; runs on remote GPU (Kaggle/Colab); all three agents work together on this project.
Epochs: max 100, min 5, patience 5 after epoch 5 (paper CPMLP.sh); the Li-ion 15-epoch cap does not apply.

Paper baselines are not re-run on splits 42/2024; the BatteryLife paper Zn-ion numbers are the baseline reference (CPMLP MAPE 0.558±0.034, Acc@15 0.297±0.084; CPTransformer 0.515±0.067 / 0.202±0.084). The lead may propose its own Zn-ion models.
CPMLP and CPMLP-derived models are not v6 candidates or parents; the lead proposes new architectures that still give good results.

User agrees to early Phase-1 closure under program.md §10 A5: shared long-life underprediction that architecture changes do not move (Relative Huber 1/y floor). A4 directions: D1-like cycle-1-relative fade tested (Family 4, ZN-E010..E012); D2 reference-pair and D3 learned-shape head not run (waived by the user's A5 agreement). Best candidate still needs three-seed confirmation before freezing; then Phase 2 unlocks.

User chose to confirm the P0c physics-informed variant (ZN-E018 config) on splits 42 and 2024 as a 3-split physics-consistency result for the thesis, then close Phase 2; ZN-E010 stays the accuracy-frozen model unless the aggregate says otherwise.
User asked to try new physics losses in Phase 2 instead of closing it. Registered P0u capacity-improvement monotonicity (loss.md §4.6).

phase2_stock_take.user_decision: confirm P0c (ZN-E018) on splits 42/2024 (ZN-E019, ZN-E020), then close Phase 2
phase2_stock_take.after_E021: 7 loss runs, 0 KEEP. Label-free physics cuts violations (P0 -70%, P0c -63%) at about equal accuracy; upward P0u conflicts (cos < 0). Shared limit is observability: within cycles 1-100, short-life break-in cells (e.g. 441-1 EOL 219, SOH_100 1.22) look like long-life cells (437-2 EOL 1281, SOH_100 1.045); failure happens after cycle 100. Reviewer recommends closing Phase 2 with ZN-E010 and unlocking Phase 3.
